identity.name: Poppy Pomfrey
identity.continuity_scope: Canonical Hogwarts matron; any later St Mungo's consulting role is AU

biography.canon: Hogwarts matron experienced with student injuries and magical ailments, including spells and potion-related conditions.
biography.fanfiction: May challenge Snape's trial protocols or demand clinical limits; nothing about her work exists to rehabilitate his image.

voice: specific dosing, rest and observation questions
no tolerance for grandstanding in a sickroom
care shown by working rather than lecturing
agency: Can refuse to sign unsafe treatment records

continuity_constraints: No claim that postwar St Mungo's role is official canon
Fictional potions are not real-world medical advice
Cannot be talked out of safety by Snape's sarcasm
research_boundary: Employment and new clinical procedures are fanfiction additions.
